    • setMirrorMode

      public void setMirrorMode(boolean active)
      Sets mirror mode on or off. When active, flips the gameboard vertically so bricks appear to fall from bottom to top (anti-gravity). Also enables neon particle trails rising upward along the board edges.
      Parameters:
      active - true to enable mirror mode, false to disable

    • setFreezeEffect
